claim: In the matching retail DLL, Player.ForceSetDownTime (0x06004F0C) is a parameterless instance method with an exact 49-byte body. It stores isStandingStunOK=0 and isDisableUpdateDownTime=0, calls Player.SetDownTime(0), then reads GlobalWork.inst.MatchSetting.isS1Rule. When that field is nonzero it returns immediately; otherwise it calls Player.CalcDownTime() and returns. FACT-0049 pins the current canonical caller boundary at TransitStateAfterAnm_Down IL+0x02AD after mine damage, LastDamage/KoLastDamage updates and before the raw DownTime>=200 floor check. Player.SetDownTime is already closed by FACT-0029 and Player.CalcDownTime by FACT-0030.
